The Most Common Irregular Verbs in Spanish

Irregular verbs don't follow standard conjugation patterns — and the most common Spanish verbs are the most irregular. Here's a guide to the ones you'll encounter every day.

The frustrating truth about Spanish irregular verbs: the more common a verb is, the more likely it is to be irregular. The verbs you use the most — ser, ir, tener, hacer — are the most unpredictable.

The good news: there are patterns, and the most important verbs are worth memorising because you’ll use them constantly.

Completely Irregular: Ser and Ir

These two are the most irregular verbs in Spanish — and ser and ir share the same preterite forms (context tells you which is which).

Ser (to be)

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presentsoyeresessomossoisson
Preteritefuifuistefuefuimosfuisteisfueron
Imperfecteraeraseraéramoseraiseran

Ir (to go)

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presentvoyvasvavamosvaisvan
Preteritefuifuistefuefuimosfuisteisfueron

Tener — To Have

Tener has a go verb in the yo present (tengo) and is irregular throughout:

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presenttengotienestienetenemostenéistienen
Preteritetuvetuvistetuvotuvimostuvisteistuvieron
Futuretendrétendrástendrátendremostendréistendrán

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presenthagohaceshacehacemoshacéishacen
Preteritehicehicistehizohicimoshicisteishicieron
Futureharéharásharáharemosharéisharán

Poder — To Be Able To

Stem-changing (o→ue in present) plus irregular preterite:

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presentpuedopuedespuedepodemospodéispueden
Preteritepudepudistepudopudimospudisteispudieron
Futurepodrépodráspodrápodremospodréispodrán

Preteritequisequisistequisoquisimosquisisteisquisieron
Futurequerréquerrásquerráquerremosquerréisquerrán

Tenseyotúélnosotrosvosotrosellos
Presentsésabessabesabemossabéissaben
Preteritesupesupistesuposupimossupisteissupieron
Futuresabrésabrássabrásabremossabréissabrán

Presentvengovienesvienevenimosvenísvienen

Patterns Worth Knowing

The “Go” Verbs (Yo Irregular)

Several verbs add -go in the yo present form but are otherwise regular in the present:

VerbYo form
tenertengo
venirvengo
hacerhago
decirdigo
ponerpongo
salirsalgo
traertraigo
caercaigo

Irregular Future/Conditional Stems

Several verbs use a contracted stem in the future and conditional:

VerbFuture stem
tenertendr-
venirvendr-
hacerhar-
poderpodr-
quererquerr-
sabersabr-
salirsaldr-
ponerpondr-
